content: For variable section types, the part <NAME> from [SWS_MemMap_00022] may contain an optional vendor specific {refinement} tag. It shall be used to refine the variable allocation or initialization behavior. The used values are vendor specific and free of choice.

For all section types, the part <NAME> from [SWS_MemMap_00022] may contain an optional vendor specific {refinement} tag. It shall be used to refine the allocation or initialization behavior (variables only). The used values are vendor specific and free of choice.
